text: Product prices are determined by looking up the relevant price for a given product and may be modified by a price modify service. The result is the price to be charged to the customer or paid to a supplier. In accounting terms this is the gross revenue per quantity for the sale of a given product to a customer. Different prices may be configured for different stores, vendors, customers, currencies, date/time ranges, and quantity breaks. These may then be modified by a rule or service that has logic such as calculating a discounted price for certain customer classifications like charging 50% of the List price (MSRP) when selling to distributors. Product price calculation can be done before adding an item to an order (or shopping cart) and is always done when a product item is added to an order unless a manual price is specified by a user allowed to do so (such as a Sales Person or Customer Service Rep).
